metadata.description: Hand-authored Claude Code skills, split into five installable plugins so you only load what you use.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: How work gets routed: plan-big-execute-small (advisor/executor orchestration), ask (Q&A delegated to a clean cheap subagent), advisor-tool (the Claude API advisor tool).

plugins.name: personal-ops
plugins.description: Personal operations: life-os (life registry as one interactive artifact), mac-doctor (diagnose a slow Mac), npm-supply-chain (supply-chain hardening recipe).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Diagrams, teaching and UI craft: tutor (explain anything as a picture-first lesson), artifact-visual-system, excalidraw, diagram-conventions, proposal-artifact, redesign-existing-projects, web-design-guidelines and the two Vercel React/Next.js guides.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Daily engineering discipline: review-policy (who reviews code and how), git-rebase-safety (never lose a commit), issue-tracking (open, update and close tracking issues in sync with the work).

plugins.name: review-tools
plugins.description: Reviewing real behavior: replicate-behavior-report (install the behavior-report pipeline), video-frame-review (diagnose a screen recording frame by frame), docx-comments.
